capabilities: Display all open notes in a tab group as one continuous scrollable document
Open folders, search results, and document links as tab groups with filtering and sorting options
Navigate between open notes with arrow keys, including navigate-in-place commands
Preview notes in Compact and Semi-Compact modes similar to Bear or Evernote
Toggle typewriter scrolling, hidden tab headers, and folder-level inline title sizing
extras: The README documents conflicts: it does not work with Obsidian's stacked tabs, conflicts with the Folder Notes plugin's single-click folder behavior, and can clash with the Vertical Tabs plugin's compact previews; workarounds are given.
intentEvidence: a continuous scrollable document (similar to “Scrivenings” in the novel-writing app, Scrivener)
motivation: The author wanted simplicity and no lock-in: unlike other similar plugins, it works with the existing file explorer structure and needs no special setup or separate project folder.
problem: Obsidian shows each open note as a separate tab, so reading or editing many notes together means constant tab switching and no sense of a single document.

summary: Workspace plugin that displays all open notes in a tab group as one continuous scrollable document, with keyboard navigation and compact preview modes.
